# Process journal

Fixture for `actions/journal-lint` in folder mode: every fragment beside this header is valid, and
the lint must pass. The header must exist; its lines are not linted, so this prose is no finding.

## Format

```
YYYY-MM-DD · <where> · <topic or —> · <what happened, one line> [ (second ask)] [ (self)] [ → codified: <path>]
```
